ns0:svg.ns0:title: JobCore Full System Architecture
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Five-layer architecture: Frontend React SPA, three Backend APIs, Core Logic engines, AI Models, and External Infrastructure of the JobCore platform.

ns0:g.onclick: sendPrompt('Describe the JobCore frontend architecture: pages, routing, auth, and Supabase integration')
ns0:g.ns0:text: Home · Dashboard · Job Agent · Mock Interview · Resume Checker · Profile
Auth: Firebase · User profiles & CV storage: Supabase · Protected routes
